text:
Ashley: ALB started deregistering ~30 pod targets in eu-west-1 around 09:12 UTC. Alerts show ALB health checks returning 503 to /health. Only services with Envoy sidecar affected. Anyone else seeing this?

infra-bot: deploy-notifier: rollout redwood/edge-api v2.3.7 -> v2.4.0 started 09:10 UTC on nodepool edge-eu-west.

Leo: saw the same. Quick repro: curl from a test pod to the podIP:8080/health often returns 503, but curl from the node host to localhost:8080 returns 200. Looks like the sidecar is returning 503 during a brief window.

James: can you paste the curl output and some envoy logs?

Ashley: here are quick checks I ran from the debug pod and the node: 

```
# from debug pod (cluster network -> pod IP)
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://10.2.3.45:8080/health
503

# from node (hostNetwork / localhost)
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
200
```

Leo: envoy logs from the failing pod show xDS reconnects and transient 'no healthy upstream' errors right after the sidecar restart: 

```
[warning] xds: ADS stream reset, reconnecting
[error] cluster edge-backend: no healthy hosts
[info] listener 0.0.0.0:8080 returning direct response 503
```

Maya: we shipped an Envoy listener/lds change in the same deploy. Sidecar restart concurrency was defaulted low and a subset of sidecars restarted before the application finished warming up. Our readiness probe hits /health which is routed through Envoy -> if Envoy has no upstream, it returns 503, so kubelet marks pod NotReady -> ALB deregisters target.

James: that explains why host-local curls succeed: hitting the app container directly bypasses Envoy. Quick mitigations:
- change readinessProbe to target the app container directly (localhost or a hostPort) or add an internal /ready-local path that the app answers before envoy startup
- add Envoy warmup (increase bootstrap/warmup timeout) so it doesn't return 503 during config churn
- throttle sidecar config rollouts (reduce concurrency)
- ALB: broaden health matcher to accept 2xx/3xx when safe

Ashley: temporary action: rolled back the envoy listener change and paused the rollout. ALB is re-registering targets slowly. Opening a follow-up ticket to add /ready-local and update Helm charts so readiness probes don't go through the sidecar.

Leo: for long-term: add explicit Envoy warmup (15s), set readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds=10 and periodSeconds=5, and add alerting for >3s continuous 503s from ALB health checks. Also document the invariant: readiness must not rely on sidecar if the sidecar can restart independently.

infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-5127 (edge-api ALB target deregistration - envoys returning 503).

Maya: noted. I'll follow up with a small chart change PR to add /ready-local and a post-deploy canary for sidecar config. :thumbsup:

James: thanks team — rolling-monitoring looks greenish, will keep an eye for reoccurrence.
